series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_style_standard: Adult cinematic physically realistic 3D historical reconstruction & live-action 65mm location cinematography (ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo primes, Kodak Vision3 500T grade: warm sandstone highlights, deep cerulean Summer Sea, lush emerald pastures, muted volcanic stone)
visual_qc_note: First pass: seven of ten frames passed and were uploaded to Drive folder 1VpOcpUx4CFeqhs9Yklgm3_ezzixvRQSM, each Drive MD5 matching its local file. The myth is carried entirely by material traces and weather — no cut to Yi Ti, no imperial court, no crown, no writing anywhere. Three frames are held: IMG0271 gave the young herdsman bare feet on volcanic scree against his locked boots and gaiters; IMG0279 repeated the Batch 027 shaved-side braid failure on two background figures and planted a wattle hurdle that reads as a gallows; IMG0280 put an ermine-like fur cloak and a snow-dusted alpine ridge into a Valyrian peninsula frame. IMG0273 was reframed from 1376x756 to full-bleed 1376x768 to remove a 12 px black strip at the bottom.

scenes.visual_beat: Low-angle up the ash cone, young herdsman a silhouette on the scree
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: REJECTED: the young herdsman stands barefoot on sharp volcanic scree — the locked wardrobe requires wrapped goat-leather gaiters and boots, and a shepherd on a pyroclastic slope without boots is a continuity break nobody can unsee. Awaiting rerender.

scenes.qc_note: Approved: elder's shoulder, sheepskin and crook soft in the near frame; the young man in profile, face turned into the mist, no irises exposed; a bank of white vapour filling the valley behind him. Boots and gaiters correct.

scenes.visual_beat: Deep-focus wide — homestead half-dissolved in a tide of volcanic mist
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved after reframing: the mist reads as real volume rather than smoke, roofs and wattle emerge and vanish, the foreground wall holds texture, and the cones are barely differentiated silhouettes. **The render carried a solid black letterbox strip across the bottom 12 px; cropped to 1376x756 and rescaled to full-bleed 1376x768 before upload.**

scenes.qc_note: Approved: receding ridgelines drowned in layered mist, three cones including one faintly smoking, a sliver of pale sea at right; entirely empty of buildings, roads and people, which is exactly the point of the frame.

scenes.qc_note: Approved: warm side key and cool fill on an attentive three-quarter face; iris crop at 450% confirms violet, and the braided temple hair matches Stage A. Background entirely featureless grey.

scenes.qc_note: Approved: one small violet glass bead on a scrap of undyed cloth among a bone awl, a hammered copper pin, three knuckle-bones and a hank of wool. No faces, no writing, no gold, nothing else exotic — the myth stays an object you could hold and cannot read.
